- PII handling: asks about redaction/pseudonymization options and whether Redwood supports automatic PII masking or post-processing hooks.
- Data residency: US-only preferred for now.
- Audit: wants audit log access for API calls and token usage tied to app user IDs.

- Pointed them to hosted_api docs + quickstart. Walked through token accounting and batching tips to reduce cost.
- Shared SOC2 + security FAQ (Drive link). Allowed to do demo with test data; emphasized we do not surface customer text to external models beyond their selected model variants.
- Engineer asked about KMS — explained hosted plan uses provider-managed keys, can provide more detail but Private (VPC) needed for customer-managed keys. Customer currently not ready to move to Private.
